parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for searching products. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results per page. Valid values: 0 to 200. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- Normal: default sorting (default value)
- Top: sorted by popularity.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
The status. Valid values:
- Available
- Deprecated.

parameters.name: terraformProviderVersion
parameters.description: The Terraform Provider version. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version is used by default.
